text: A lot of words would puzzle me. Bananas was no sin. That's Cinderella. That was hard, but I could spell it in a pinch. But words like this are matter. Psychological and such. Gee, when it came to spelling those, I surely was in Dutch. I can't spell Cinderella and sausages better than cups. But I can spell Mississippi. And believe me, that's enough.
